antenatal_route_inventory.note: Static inventory of frontend routes requiring antenatal/postnatal access control. CP0 inventories surfaces only; does not implement or test the frontend gatekeeper.
antenatal_route_inventory.status: NEEDS-EXTERNAL — exact route paths require frontend codebase inspection.

onboarding.gating: Authenticated; redirects to dashboard if setup complete
onboarding.cp0_concern: Must not be accessible anonymously; must require authentication

tracking_dashboard.gating: Authenticated; requires at least one child or antenatal profile
tracking_dashboard.cp0_concern: Child-dependent cards must not render without active child records

child_selector.gating: Authenticated; lists children owned by user
child_selector.cp0_concern: Cannot display or access other users' children

child_creation.cp0_concern: Ownership spoofing prevented (T-INJECT-CREATE-ANON-ADMIN covers users; children enforced separately)

growth_tracking.gating: Authenticated; child must belong to current user
growth_tracking.cp0_concern: Access denied if child does not belong to user (T-FILE-AUTH-1 covers growth_logs)

immunisations.cp0_concern: immunisations collection access; must not show other children's records

newborn_postnatal_courses.cp0_concern: courses, enrollments, lesson_progress — postnatal only accessible post-delivery

articles_and_bookmarks.gating: Authenticated; antenatal articles filtered by is_pregnancy=true

notification_history.cp0_concern: notifications, notification_preferences — cannot view another user's notifications

push_deep_links.gating: Deep links must re-authenticate before rendering child-dependent content
push_deep_links.cp0_concern: push_subscriptions; deep link cannot bypass child ownership check

service_worker_cached_routes.gating: Cached routes must not serve stale auth state
service_worker_cached_routes.cp0_concern: Inventory of cached routes requires SW inspection; NEEDS-EXTERNAL

single_outcome_design.selftest: PASS/PASS, PASS/FAIL, FAIL/PASS all detected via isolated _st_rec()
single_outcome_design.static_dedup: pbj_dupeid.py scans harness source for duplicate literal test IDs
